title: Ruin Bars and the Reinvention of the Inner Districts
grammar: Spatial-directional postpositions in relative clauses (amely felé, amely köré, amelyeken keresztül)
goal: I can analyze the rise of ruin bars (romkocsmák) and cultural revival in Budapest's historic 7th District.
I can construct relative clauses with directional postpositions (felé, köré, át/keresztül).
I can evaluate heritage conservation, alternative art spaces, and overtourism in Hungarian.
